'''Aryx''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], warm-blooded avians that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]].

==Biology and appearance==
The species was [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]],<ref name=":0">{{FactFile|135|CER 1-2|Cereans}}</ref> and when at full height, aryx were far taller than [[Cerean/Legends|Cereans]], the sentient species with which they shared their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Aryx possessed a large [[Color/Legends|yellow]] beak and a pair of black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] on their head as well as a large tuft of feathers at the back of their [[Bone/Legends|skull]]. Feathers also covered the rest of their bodies, including a pair of wings on either side of their torso, but excepting the aryx's pair of [[Limb/Legends|legs]], which were yellow in color like their beak. Each leg ended in three digits, two at the front of the foot and one at the back, each of which had a black talon at its end. Aryx feathers could be white and blue in color,<ref name=":1">[[Star Wars (1998) 1|''Star Wars'' (1998) 1]]</ref> with some individuals having only white feathers<ref name=":2">[[Star Wars (1998) 6|''Star Wars'' (1998) 6]]</ref> and others having a mix of the two colors.

==History==
Aryx were domesticated and ridden by the Cereans<ref name=":1" /> over generations,<ref name=":0" /> who used them as individual transports when moving around on the vast grassy plains of their homeworld<ref name=":2" /> or within cities. While being ridden, the birds wore saddles for their riders to sit on and had reins for the rider to control them with attached to their beaks. One Cerean who rode an [[Ki-Adi Mundi's aryx|aryx]] was the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] while he was on Cerea.<ref name=":1" /> He rode it after returning to the planet shortly after reaching knighthood in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During this visit, he was accused of [[Death/Legends|murder]]<ref name=":1" /> but was acquitted and sent to capture the true culprit, another Cerean, named [[Maj-Odo-Nomor]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 2" /> While attempting to track down Nomor, he rode his aryx to [[Outsider Citadel/Legends|Outsider Citadel]],<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 2" /> a city built for off-worlders on Cerea,<ref name=":1" /> to meet an [[Ydde|informant]] who might be able to help him with the case. While he was there, a group of thugs attacked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to summon his aryx to defend him. The bird attacked the thugs and was able to wound several of them with its talons and throw others away from the combat. After the fight, Mundi calmed it again with the Force.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 2" />
